title: 1RB0LE_0LC0RB_1RD1LD_1RA1LF_0LB1LE_---1LB: a trip into the word can become a clock of its own
text: A trip into a word that starts 0 1<sup>4+3k</sup> 0 Z is, after its first pass, tick k of a nested clock. If its 2<sup>k</sup> trips into Z return, it reaches the start of tick k+1 in E + 19·2<sup>k</sup> − 8 steps (Lean, every k and every word). So trips can't be listed: the prefixes that leave a trip undecided grow about 1.7 times per cell. Searches for an invariant that forgets the word, with a derived right automaton, find none with up to 7 left states, nor with windows of 10 cells.
